captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, S-shaped desk hook designed to clamp onto a desk edge and provide a hanging post. It consists of a central flat plate from which two rectangular cutouts are subtracted on opposite sides to form two opposing hooks. One end of the outer hook terminates in a small, cylindrical vertical catch to prevent hung items from slipping off.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, customizable desk hook in OpenSCAD. The design should feature an S-shaped profile with adjustable overall width, length, and height, customizable clamp and hook gap widths, adjustable thickness, and an optional cylindrical catch at the tip of the hook.
captions.factory: The code defines a helper module 'roundedRect' that uses linear_extrude and hull on four circles to create a rounded base block. Two rectangular cutouts ('clamp' and 'hook') are subtracted from this base using the difference operator. Finally, if the 'add_catch' boolean is true, a cylinder is unioned at the tip of the hook to act as a retaining catch.
